title: promote only an accepted image with reviewed provenance
input: The release team defines source review, trusted build, artifact scanning and deployment acceptance policy.
action: The configured supply-chain controls connect supported source, build, artifact and deployment evidence. Build services produce provenance, scanners report issues and deployment policy enforces the selected acceptance rule; each component has a distinct responsibility.
output: The release pipeline deploys the verified artifact digest after its required checks succeed.
check: Test an untrusted artifact, missing provenance, critical finding and rollback to the previous accepted digest.

title: apply a supported partner sovereignty boundary to a workload
input: The compliance owner selects the actual partner offering, jurisdiction and required key or access controls.
action: Sovereign Controls by Partners combines the supported partner and cloud controls under the chosen offering. External key or access mechanisms depend on its documented configuration; the workload must still implement application authorization and data policy.
output: The owner deploys within the accepted boundary and records actual partner and customer responsibilities.
check: Verify effective key access, location restrictions, exceptions and operational evidence before asserting sovereignty coverage.

title: authorize permitted CBRS radio operation through spectrum coordination
input: The radio operator registers supported CBSD equipment and the required location and operating parameters.
action: Spectrum Access System coordinates eligible spectrum grants and related authorization for registered CBRS devices. Radios transmit only under their accepted grant and heartbeat conditions; SAS is not the enterprise application data path.
output: The operator's radio network serves permitted devices while observing granted channel and power constraints.
check: Test registration, grant heartbeat, suspension response and accurate installation parameters before radio operation.

title: transcribe an authorized meeting recording
input: The meeting application submits permitted audio and the selected recognition configuration.
action: Speech-to-Text converts supported audio into transcription results according to configured language and recognition settings. The application aligns timestamps and reviews important speaker or terminology errors.
output: The reviewer corrects material transcript errors and publishes the accepted meeting notes.
check: Check audio quality, terminology, consent and recording access before retaining or sharing the transcript.

title: match an approved job search to the configured job catalog
input: The employment application supplies permitted search criteria and the approved job dataset.
action: Talent Solutions' selected supported API indexes or matches job information under its configured schema. Search output suggests relevant listings; the employer applies its own eligibility, hiring and fairness requirements.
output: The applicant sees validated available listings and submits applications through the employer's actual process.
check: Check stale listings, search relevance, sensitive-profile use and the current supported API scope before publication.

title: orchestrate an approved telecom network deployment
input: The operator supplies supported network-function definitions and target infrastructure configuration.
action: Telecom Network Automation coordinates supported deployment or lifecycle workflows using the configured network automation architecture. Deployed network functions handle traffic; automation definitions control provisioning and updates.
output: The operator validates the instantiated network service before expanding its deployment.
check: Check artifact versions, infrastructure readiness, function health and rollback before carrying operational subscribers.

title: prepare a permitted subscriber insight for operator review
input: The operator supplies authorized subscriber data and the defined analytical use case.
action: Telecom Subscriber Insights' supported capabilities extract relevant information from configured telecom datasets. Data consent and schema mapping bound analysis; the operator reviews any recommended customer action.
output: The service team applies its approved outreach or assistance policy to the validated subscriber insight.
check: Check consent, source freshness, false inferences and customer-data access before using the insight.

title: maintain a supported TensorFlow experiment with pinned dependencies
input: The ML maintainer selects the supported TensorFlow distribution and approved training environment.
action: TensorFlow Enterprise's selected supported distribution and integrations provide framework compatibility or support capabilities. Training code runs in its actual compute runtime; the distribution is not an independent managed model-training endpoint.
output: The team reproduces the accepted training run and publishes its validated model artifact.
check: Check current framework support, package versions, accelerator compatibility and reproducible evaluation before upgrading.

title: synthesize an approved accessibility narration
input: The application supplies permitted text, language and the supported voice configuration.
action: Text-to-Speech generates audio from supported text or markup using the selected voice settings. The application controls the narration content and stores or streams the returned audio under its access policy.
output: The learner plays the generated narration for the authorized lesson.
check: Check pronunciation, markup limits, voice suitability and access to sensitive narration content before publication.

title: convert a stored video into accepted playback renditions
input: The media owner provides the approved source object and job encoding configuration.
action: Transcoder API processes the stored input through the configured supported transcoding job and writes its outputs. Codec, audio and packaging settings define the renditions; it is a file workflow rather than a live-feed encoder.
output: The delivery application serves only the accepted manifests or output files through its configured origin.
check: Verify job completion, duration, audio and captions and reject incomplete output sets before publication.
